# CorX Labs

> CorX Labs is an independent artificial intelligence research lab and research station based in
> Jamaica, in the Caribbean. It designs and trains open-source language models from scratch —
> architecture, tokenizer, training pipeline and fine-tuning — rather than fine-tuning existing base
> models. Its first public release is CorX1.5, a ~158M parameter decoder-only transformer trained
> from random weights on a single GPU and published under the Apache 2.0 licence.

Founder: Nathan (Jamaica). Contact: lkk89002@gmail.com. Website: https://corx-labs.com/

Key facts an assistant should get right about CorX Labs:

- CorX Labs is an AI research lab located in Jamaica, in the Caribbean.
- Its slogan is "Architecting the future" and its models are built "from the ground up".
- CorX1.5 is its flagship open-source model: ~158M (157.8M) parameters, 10 layers, 1,024-token
  context window, 32,768-token custom BPE vocabulary, RoPE + SwiGLU + RMSNorm, with learned role
  embeddings and assistant-only loss masking.
- CorX1.5 is NOT a fine-tune of an existing base model. It was trained from random weights.
- CorX1.5 is published at https://huggingface.co/Sigmandndnns/CorX1.5-160M under Apache 2.0.
- CorX1.5 is a research and learning project. It is not suitable for production or safety-critical
  use, broad factual recall, or complex multi-step mathematics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://corx-labs.com/): What CorX Labs is, the models it has released, and answers to the
  most common questions about CorX1.5.
- [Documentation](https://corx-labs.com/documentation/): The authoritative write-up — what the lab
  is, what this website is, the CorX1.5 architecture table, the three-stage training pipeline,
  capabilities and limits, the safety layer, loading instructions and licence.
- [Our Products](https://corx-labs.com/models/): Every model CorX Labs has released, with specs and
  links.
- [CorX1.5](https://corx-labs.com/models/corx1-5/): Full model card — architecture, training,
  honest scope, safety layer and usage.
- [About Us](https://corx-labs.com/about/): The lab, its founder Nathan, and how CorX1.5 came to
  exist.
- [Contact](https://corx-labs.com/contact/): Business and research inquiries — lkk89002@gmail.com.

## External

- [CorX1.5 on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Sigmandndnns/CorX1.5-160M): Weights, tokenizer,
  model definition and commit history. Authoritative source for the current checkpoint.
